reviews.text: this is probably THE prettiest highlighter i’ve used in my 28 years of life 😭😭😭 i absolutely love the color and it looks amazing on the face
reviews.zh: 呢個可能係我 28 年人生入面用過最靚嘅 highlight 😭😭😭 我絕對鍾意呢個顏色，上面之後效果好正。

reviews.text: This is best beam glow in my opinion. The color is just right, not too pink. I received a lot of compliments from my colleagues. It added just right amount of shimmer to glow your face. It lasts more than 10 hours, just slightly fading. Definitely recommend to everyone try out this product.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢個係最好用嘅 beam glow。顏色啱啱好，唔會太粉。收咗唔少同事嘅讚美。適量嘅閃粉令成塊面有光澤。持久度超過 10 個鐘，只係有少少減淡。強烈推薦每個人都試下呢款產品。

reviews.text: Good kind of pink in real life skin ?But nice shiny can be a bit dry but I guess most powders are just do good prep if you have dry skin
reviews.zh: 上到真實皮膚上係靚嘅粉紅色？閃粉靚，可能有少少乾，但我諗大部分粉都係咁，乾性肌做好打底就得。

reviews.text: Very pretty and pigmented. Idk if its the most long lasting. I also broke the package very quickly with the part snapping it close falling off.
reviews.zh: 好靚又顯色。唔知係咪最持久。我好快就整爛咗個包裝，係開合嗰個位跌咗落嚟。

reviews.text: Such a pretty highlight! Looks so glowy and yet still natural with a slightly peachy tone. Blends beautiful into the skin too. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 真係好靚嘅 highlight！望落去好有光澤但又夠自然，帶少少桃色調，融入皮膚都好好睇。高度推薦。

reviews.text: The prettiest pink highlighter ever. Wanted one without gold pearls and this is perfect as blush topper
reviews.zh: 史上最美嘅粉紅 highlight。一直都想要冇金色珠光嘅，呢個啱啱好可以當胭脂 topper。

reviews.text: sparkles match perfectly to my skin tone, give natural glow, not pink, brown or orange, but there is no mirror like in blush, a little bit disappointed
reviews.zh: 閃粉同膚色完全夾，畀到自然嘅光澤，唔會偏粉、啡或者橙。不過同胭脂嗰個唔同，冇鏡，有少少失望。

reviews.text: I purchased BOTH of these because they were just too cute. Like the lilybyred blusher, this feels like its between a cream and a powder texture wise. I haven't worn them out in the sun yet but I did do a swatch indoors. I swatched them with natural light as well as with camera flash
reviews.zh: 兩隻都買咗，因為實在太可愛。同 lilybyred 胭脂一樣，質地感覺介乎霜同粉之間。仲未著出街喺太陽下試過，不過室內試過色，分別用咗自然光同相機閃光燈試。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
